management_major_statements.value: Company stated AI-driven memory and storage growth was outpacing industry supply in Q3 FY2026, with robust DRAM and NAND demand and constrained supply contributing to higher pricing and improved profitability across the portfolio.
management_major_statements.original_location: MD&A Industry Conditions / Memory and Storage Demand

management_major_statements.value: Company stated customers are increasingly seeking committed long-term access to advanced memory technology and supply; strategic agreements provide customers supply assurance and pricing visibility and provide Micron greater visibility and stability.

CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said Micron is aligning its organization to meet customer needs in an AI-enabled future and expressed confidence in Manish Bhatia and Scott DeBoer to guide the company through the next phase of innovation and growth.

leadership_changes.value: Manish Bhatia appointed President and Chief Operating Officer, effective immediately; expanded accountability includes global operations and business units and operating P&L spanning capital investment, manufacturing execution, customer demand, pricing and delivery.

Scott DeBoer appointed President and Chief Technology and Products Officer, effective immediately; responsibilities include technology and product roadmap, Micron Research Labs and customer technology requirements.
Sumit Sadana transitioned from Executive Vice President and Chief Business Officer to Senior Advisor to the CEO.

important_changes.value: FY2025 revenue was $37.378 billion versus $25.111 billion in FY2024; company reported a 49% increase.
FY2025 operating income was $9.770 billion and operating margin 26%, versus $1.304 billion and 5% in FY2024.
Q3 FY2026 revenue was $41.456 billion versus $23.860 billion in Q2 FY2026; company reported total revenue increased 74% sequentially, driven by DRAM and NAND sales increases.

Q3 FY2026 consolidated gross margin was 85% versus 74% in Q2 FY2026; company attributed the improvement to DRAM and NAND margin improvements, primarily ASP increases, with continued execution and favorable mix also contributing.

FY2026 capex estimate increased from the FY2025 year-end disclosure of a $4.5 billion Q1 baseline for planned FY2026 spending to a current FY2026 estimate of approximately $27 billion net of government incentives.

important_changes.note: The two disclosures use different framing: one is a Q1 quarterly baseline, the other is a full-year estimate. They are preserved without deriving a percentage change.

risk_related_new_disclosures.value: On 2025-10-06, YMTC filed multiple patent infringement complaints against Micron and subsidiaries in the Eastern District of Texas, the English High Court, the Unified Patent Court in Dusseldorf, and Munich Regional Court alleging infringement by certain 3D NAND, LPDRAM, NAND and DRAM products; complaints seek injunctions, attorneys' fees, damages and costs.
risk_related_new_disclosures.note: Event occurred after the FY2025 Form 10-K filing date of 2025-10-03.

risk_related_new_disclosures.value: On 2026-03-06, Nextech Semiconductor filed a patent infringement complaint against Micron and MSP in the Western District of Texas alleging six U.S. patents are infringed by certain DRAM, NAND and SSD products and seeking an injunction, damages, attorneys' fees and costs.

On 2026-05-21, the appeals court affirmed the German Federal Patent Court invalidity ruling for one Netlist patent; the appeal concerning the second patent had not yet been decided as of the Q3 filing.

Q3 filing states demand for HBM and other advanced products may fluctuate; HBM requires more wafers and cleanroom space per bit than conventional DRAM, and a shift of capacity from HBM to conventional DRAM if HBM demand weakens could increase conventional DRAM supply and pressure pricing.
